market.question: Will Bitcoin dip to $50,000 by December 31, 2026?

assessment.reasoning: BTC at ~$78k requires a -36% drawdown by year-end (8 months). Multiple analysts (Kendrick, others) explicitly call out $50k as a Q2-Q3 capitulation target if the four-year cycle plays out. Recent low was ~$65k. A -36% drawdown over 8 months has solid base-rate precedent in BTC history. Less extreme than $45k threshold.
assessment.key_uncertainty: ETF flow regime stability vs. cyclical post-halving correction; macro shock probability hard to quantify 8 months out.
